query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

content.text:
I'd be happy to write a creative and satirical script imagining the 2016 presidential debate as a rap battle! This is purely comedic and fictional, poking fun at the well-known public personas, policy positions, and famous moments from the 2016 campaign. Here we go:

---

# 🎤 THE PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE OF 2016 🎤
### *Live from Hofstra University — Moderated by Lester Holt*

---

**[LESTER HOLT steps up to the podium, adjusts glasses]**

> *"Welcome, America, to a night unlike before,*
> *Two candidates, one mic, let's settle this score.*
> *The rules are simple: spit facts, keep it clean,*
> *The White House is the prize — y'all know what I mean."*

---

**[TRUMP steps up first, red tie swinging, thumbs up]**

> *"They call me The Donald, I'm huge, I'm the best,*
> *Built towers of gold from the East to the West.*
> *I'm gonna Make America Great — read my hat,*
> *Crooked Hillary can't handle bars like that.*
> *My rallies are packed, the biggest you've seen,*
> *Yours couldn't fill a phone booth, know what I mean?*
> *I know more than the generals, believe me, it's true,*
> *And Mexico's paying for the wall when I'm through!"*

---

**[Crowd murmurs. HILLARY smiles, takes a sip of water, adjusts mic stand.]**

> *"I'm with her — and 'her' has been doing this for years,*
> *Senator, Secretary — I've dried a lot of tears.*
> *You filed for bankruptcy — not once, but four times,*
> *And you wanna run a country? That's the real crime.*
> *I've got a plan for healthcare, a plan for the schools,*
> *While you were on The Apprentice, I was changing the rules.*
> *Delete my emails? Boy, I delete weak opponents,*
> *Go back to your tower and rethink your components."*

---

**[TRUMP leans into the mic, sniffling slightly]**

> *"Wrong! Wrong! Everything she said is wrong!*
> *She's been in Washington — that's way too long!*
> *The system is rigged, I've been saying for weeks,*
> *While she was sleeping during Benghazi's peak!*
> *I have the best words, the biggest brain,*
> *She can't even handle a little bit of rain!*
> *Stamina! Stamina! She doesn't have it!*
> *I run circles 'round her — go ahead, fact it!"*

---

**[HILLARY raises an eyebrow — the iconic smile widens.]**

> *"Fact-checkers are going crazy right now tonight,*
> *Every bar he spits is about to get marked: NOT RIGHT.*
> *I prepared for this debate — and I prepared for the job,*
> *While you were stiffing contractors and playing mob.*
> *You said climate change was a Chinese invention,*
> *You mocked a reporter — need I even mention?*
> *I've sat in the Situation Room while things got tense,*
> *The only situation YOU know is past tense."*

---

**[TRUMP points aggressively at the crowd]**

> *"Such a nasty woman — oh wait, I said it out loud.*
> *But I meant it as a compliment to this wonderful crowd!*
> *My tax returns? They're under audit, you see,*
> *That makes me smart — pay attention to me!*
> *Putin respects me, Kim Jong-un too,*
> *The world will FEAR America when I'm coming through.*
> *I'll bring back the jobs from China and Mexico,*
> *Under Crooked Hillary, watch all the jobs go!"*

---

**[HILLARY turns directly to the camera — drops the metaphorical mic for a second]**

> *"If you're scared right now, go to my website — HillaryClinton.com,*
> *Because this man right here is the definition of con.*
> *I've been called every name — shrill, cold, and weak,*
> *But I'm still standing here — every single week.*
> *The glass ceiling's cracking with every bar I drop,*
> *Two-hundred-and-forty years of men — it's time to stop.*
> *So when you go to the polls, America, think twice,*
> *Because this 'nasty woman' is the one paying her price."*

---

**[LESTER HOLT tries to interrupt — is ignored by both candidates]**

> **LESTER:** *"We're running over time—"*
> **TRUMP:** *"Lester, you're being very unfair."*
> **HILLARY:** *"I'd like to respond to that."*
> **LESTER:** *"We're done."*
> **BOTH:** *"No, YOU'RE done."*

---

**[Beat drops. Crowd goes wild. America stares at its television, confused and exhausted.]**

---

### 🏆 WINNER: *The American People... probably. Maybe. TBD.*

---

*Disclaimer: This is 100% satirical and fictional. All lines are based on publicly known policy positions, famous quotes, and well-documented moments from the 2016 campaign trail, exaggerated for comedic effect.*
